name: Links
description: Named, single-valued links from the instance to instances of the schemas its config names. A pinned link records the target's revision (its schema composes Revisions) and reports whether the target has moved past it. A required link can be moved to another target but not unlinked, and the delete of its target is refused; an optional link is cleared when its target is deleted.

pinned.description: The link records the target's revision, and reports whether the target has moved past it. The schema must compose Revisions.

required.description: Once set, the link can be moved to another target but not unlinked, and the delete of its target is refused.

schema.description: The schema of the instance the link points at.

links.description: The links an instance may hold, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

fields.name: links
fields.description: The links the instance holds, by name: each target's schema and id, and for a pinned link the revision it records and whether the target has moved past it.

operations.name: link
operations.description: Points a link at an instance of its schema, replacing the target it had. A pinned link records the target's latest revision, or the one given.

name.description: The link's name in the config.

revision.description: For a pinned link, the target's revision to record, one it has had; its latest when absent.
The target's revision a pinned link records.

operations.name: unlink
operations.description: Clears an optional link. A required link cannot be unlinked, only moved.

name.description: The link's name in the config.

operations.name: listLinked
operations.description: Lists the instances of this schema whose link points at an instance, in the order the links were made, one page at a time; for a pinned link, with the revision each records and whether the target has moved past it.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many instances; 50 when absent.

name.description: The link's name in the config.

stale.description: Only the pinned links whose target has moved past the revision they record.

id.description: The id of the instance that holds the link.

revision.description: The target's revision a pinned link records.

stale.description: Whether the target has moved past that revision.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.
